## Review checklist (D4)

- [ ] Spec alignment — the change serves a requirement's fit criterion
- [ ] Architecture alignment — module boundaries and the element map hold
- [ ] Code & test quality — negative test included, tests approved
- [ ] Operational metadata — AI-use log updated, debt/bug records touched
- [ ] Security & efficiency — fail-closed paths unchanged or re-approved
- [ ] Blocking gates green (schema, static analysis, safety paths, baseline,
      test approval, offline, regression, semantic, AI-use log)

**Verdict:** APPROVE / CHANGES REQUIRED / REJECT
